origin: Researcher-designed, iterated from v1 after v1's yearly breakdown showed a COVID-crash-driven losing period
thesis: Fade a break of the pre-London consolidation range, betting on reversion back into the range rather than continuation. A prior continuation-based strategy (london_orb) failed on the same setup, motivating the opposite (fade) thesis.

filters.note: v2 adds the rolling-average volatility filter on top of v1's breakout-buffer + min-range floor, specifically to filter out COVID-crash-style volatility shock days

entry.trigger: completed M15 bar closes more than 10 pips beyond the range high/low (bar-close confirmation, not intrabar touch)
entry.side: sell if closed above range (fade back down), buy if closed below range (fade back up)

stop_loss: 1x day's range size beyond the breakout extreme
take_profit: 1x day's range size back across the range

exit.rule: force-close any open position at 20:00 server time -- day trading only, never holds overnight

tunable_parameters_swept: BreakoutBufferPips, MinRangeSizePips, SLMultiplier, TPMultiplier (v1 sweep); MaxRangeVsAvgMultiplier and RangeHistoryWindow added and tuned in v2

demo_criteria.rationale: Standard day_trading category anchor applies -- ~40 trades/year historically, no unusual frequency profile.
